verdict.rationale: Vercel has its own project configuration file, vercel.json, which the docs show setting regions per project and per function. Deployments are driven from Git on every push, so committed config is versioned with the code. However, nothing shows one file defining the whole architecture: databases and Redis come from Marketplace integrations, and environments, domains and access controls are managed separately. Missing for 10: evidence that one file declares all resources (storage, databases, env vars, domains, protection), a documented full vercel.json schema reference, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can define, deploy, and version my entire architecture with a single configuration file
